4) Redwood to surface alternatives if PO timeline is delayed (short-term card + invoice cadence) and note any price/commitment changes (Marissa)

Notes on compliance: we can run Private deployment for air-gapped / VPC requirements if needed, but that will affect lead time/cost — happy to scope once we see the questionnaire. Also, we can support marketplace procurement in many regions; I can follow up with our marketplace team if that is your path.

Please reply with the procurement contact and any additional gating questions. If helpful, we can set a 30-min alignment with procurement and security next week.

- Security artifacts: please complete our vendor questionnaire (I'll attach in a follow-up) — priority items are SOC 2 Type II report and explanation of data retention, KV cache handling, and private deployment options.
- DPA: we have our standard DPA; happy to start with your draft and redline. Legal copies to: procurement@aureliahealth.com and sam.patel@aureliahealth.com.

Tentative timeline: procurement sign-off target is by end of month (10/29) if documents and questionnaire are returned this week. If SOC 2 evidences and the questionnaire answers are delayed, the timeline will slip.
